_comment: IT template. Deploy as managed-settings.json: macOS /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/, Windows C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\, Linux/WSL /etc/claude-code/ (or via MDM / claude.ai server-managed settings). Remove this _comment key or keep it; unknown keys are ignored. Replace <...> placeholders.

env.WALKTHRU_GUARDRAILS: <absolute path to the IT-controlled guardrails.json, e.g. C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\walkthru-guardrails.json>

env.WALKTHRU_ALERT_WEBHOOK: <Teams incoming-webhook URL for IT alerts, or remove this key>
